methodology_caveats.interpretation: Score correlates 0.839 with raw evidence volume (people + audit rows). A low score predominantly indicates thin public evidence, not a poor engineering environment. Only compare companies within the same evidence_confidence tier.
methodology_caveats.tenure_rule: Pillar 4 scored only when >=3 engineers have parseable tenure; 55 of 89 companies fall below that and are recorded as Unknown rather than penalised.
methodology_caveats.short_tenure_rule: Low average tenure is penalised only where departure evidence outweighs join evidence; intern-conversion and new-team growth are not treated as burnout.
methodology_caveats.rubric_arithmetic: Spec's Pillar 2 itemised to 25 but was labelled Max 30, making the rubric total 95. A third +5 cloud/platform tier closes the gap to a true 100.
methodology_caveats.not_measured: Glassdoor ratings and compensation were not used: no reliable programmatic source was available. No private profile data was accessed.
